instructions.original_snippets: NEVER write a JSDoc comment that only restates the type signature
instructions.content: Never write a JSDoc comment that only restates a parameter or return type the signature already shows; document behavior, intent, and edge cases the signature can't express.

instructions.original_snippets: Include a realistic @example in JSDoc for non-trivial functions
instructions.content: Include a realistic @example block in JSDoc for a non-trivial function so a reader sees a plausible call site, not just a type signature.

instructions.original_snippets: Exclude internal members from generated TypeDoc output
instructions.content: Configure TypeDoc to exclude private and internal members so generated documentation only covers the intended public API surface.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER write an ADR that only justifies a decision already made
instructions.content: Never write an ADR that only justifies a decision already made; record the alternatives considered and the consequences accepted, not just the chosen option's benefits.

instructions.original_snippets: Follow a standard ADR structure (Context, Decision, Alternatives, Consequences)
instructions.content: Follow a standard ADR structure (Title, Status, Context, Decision, Alternatives Considered, Consequences) so a future reader who wasn't in the room can find and judge the reasoning.
